title: Abandoned vehicles; repeat offender; penalty.
bodyText:
A person who is the registered owner of a vehicle that was deemed abandoned or derelict pursuant to this chapter shall be subject to a fine for each vehicle as follows:

(1) For the third violation, a fine of $750; and

(2) For a fourth or subsequent violation, a fine of $1,000.
bodyHtml:
[§290-46]  Abandoned vehicles; repeat offender; penalty.  A person who is the registered owner of a vehicle that was deemed abandoned or derelict pursuant to this chapter shall be subject to a fine for each vehicle as follows:

     (1)  For the third violation, a fine of $750; and

     (2)  For a fourth or subsequent violation, a fine of $1,000. [L 2022, c 297, §2]
